description: Header file defining the Service class within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It declares the Service class which implements the IShell interface, along with a nested Config class for configuration management. The file includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to plugin service management, web server configuration, and metadata handling.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a plugin service implementing the IShell interface, managing configuration, state, web server settings, and metadata.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Nested class within Service that manages plugin configuration parameters, including paths, supported versions, and other settings.

methods.name: Versions
methods.description: Returns the supported versions of the plugin as a string.

methods.name: StartupOrder
methods.description: Returns the startup order of the plugin.

methods.name: Locator
methods.description: Returns the locator string for the plugin.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the plugin.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the callsign identifier of the plugin.

methods.name: WebPrefix
methods.description: Returns the web prefix URL for the plugin.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Returns the current configuration line as a string.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Sets a new configuration line; returns error code.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage path.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Returns the volatile storage path.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Returns the data storage path.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Returns the system root path.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Sets the system root path.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the service.

methods.name: AutoStart
methods.description: Returns whether the service is set to auto-start.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Returns whether the service is resumed.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given version number is supported.

methods.name: EnableWebServer
methods.description: Configures the web server with a URL postfix and root path.

methods.name: DisableWebServer
methods.description: Disables the web server functionality.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Returns the plugin configuration object.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the service is active.

methods.name: IsHibernated
methods.description: Checks if the service is hibernated.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the service has an error message.

methods.name: ErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the current error message.

methods.name: GetMetaData
methods.description: Fills a MetaData::Service object with current metadata.

methods.name: AutoStart
methods.description: Sets the auto-start property of the service.

methods.name: IsWebServerRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request segment is for the web server.

methods.name: Notification
methods.description: Sends a notification message (rest API).

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON elements based on an identifier.
